== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Sonic Bombardment (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-sonicbombardment-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-17-Sonic_Bombardment.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Once per game, may take into hand a prison from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Use 1 Force to take into hand a non-droid assassin or slaver of ability < 5 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle involving an assassin, each of opponent's battle destiny draws is -1. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to modify the power of a starship piloted by your alien.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>601_27</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
